title: A replayable certificate and formal reduction for the ten-label obstruction without downward closure
description:
Version 1.1.0 preserves the accepted 18,302-addition RUP certificate for the finite ten-label obstruction without downward closure and adds a Lean proof of the forward source-to-CNF reduction. The source fields tetra_card, pure, no_boundary, complementary and pair_count are retained for arbitrary subset-family T and nonempty Q. No down, fixed facet, or T-membership premise on no-boundary is added. Pico made the earlier omission observation; the contribution is independently checkable evidence and formalization, not discovery of that observation.

The Lean theorem produces a satisfying assignment of the generated numeric CNF. Complete external comparison matches all 330 ordered variable meanings and 30,361 clauses, including multiplicities; raw and retained obligation counts agree. The pinned Lean v4.33.1 / Mathlib 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474 build uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The packet contains all 55 prior certificate files unchanged, 24 formal-bridge files, source hashes, licenses, instructions, tests, controls, and fresh staged verification logs. The staged checks include 29 certificate tests, 17 bridge tests, a complete watched-literal replay and optimized rejection controls; the previously completed full-scan replay is preserved and was not repeated solely for archiving.

This is a kernel-checked forward reduction combined with external certificate verification and an external serialized-input binding. The final Lean corollary explicitly assumes UNSAT. No kernel-checked certificate replay, reverse equivalence, complete source-project build, geometry, topology, new Borsuk theorem, human peer review or global novelty is claimed. PR11 was accepted on 21 October 2026; PR12 remained open without review findings at archival preparation. Archival publication does not imply acceptance of the formalization.

Alexander Richard Towell contributed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code, checking, writing, scoped separate AI review and archival packaging. Credit OpenAI for the source definition and finite lemmas, Pico / Håkon Åmdal for the prior observation and later reproductions, earlier Towell/Codex certificate work for reused checking engines, Glucose/PySAT for optional generation, and Lean/Mathlib contributors. The compilation and new archive note are Apache-2.0; individual MIT and Apache-2.0 component notices are preserved. AI review is not human peer review.

Exact selected source commit: d3461179d6d7161ba3ae6241f09f1b160179b70a. Original certificate disclosure: 20 October 2026 at 11:43:46 UTC; formal bridge disclosure: 21 October 2026 at 08:22:22 UTC. These dates are separate from this archive publication. Prior version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23498223 remains unchanged.
